marks.gloss_en: אם טומאה עוררת טומאה, טהרה עוררת טומאה? -- in the teruma case impure chullin revive the impurity; in the brine the pot's water is pure
and it was taught on it: those chullin according to R' Eliezer -- they are eaten dry or roasted, or kneaded with fruit juice, or divided into doughs, provided there is not an egg-bulk in one place
איתיביה: majority hearth ashes -- no impurity; if impurity is as though present, granted not by contact, let it impart by carrying!
[Rav Dimi's position, as Abaye formulates it:] nullified impurity is as though it were present
הא איתמר עלה: R' Yosei b'R' Chanina -- pure by contact, but it does impart by carrying (p_rybch_efer_masa_tamei)
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina [on the ashes mishna]: [the hearth-ash majority mixture] is pure from imparting impurity by contact
והאמר רב חסדא: a carcass is nullified in slaughtered meat -- granted not by contact, let it impart by carrying! (kind svara under protest: an amoraic-memra contradiction)
Rav Chisda: a carcass is nullified in slaughtered meat, since a carcass cannot become slaughtered meat
אתון בדרב חסדא מתניתו לה, אנן בדרבי חייא מתנינן לה: R' Chiyya -- they nullify each other, and R' Yosei b'R' Chanina on it -- impure by carrying (p_rybch_nevela_masa_tamei)
R' Chiyya teaches: carcass and slaughtered meat nullify each other
והא דתנן (R' Eliezer b. Yaakov's mass of blood) and R' Chiyya: not by contact nor by carrying -- why? let it impart by carrying! אישתיק (Rav Dimi was silent)
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: a large animal that expelled a mass of blood -- it is buried, and [the animal] is exempt from the firstborn obligation

דלמא ודאי שאני הכא, דהויא לה טומאה סרוחה -- perhaps it differs here: it is decayed impurity. VALID ONLY FOR BAR PADDA (הניחא לבר פדא... הא לא חזיא לגר); for R' Yochanan it fails -- see the kashya at 23b.1
bar Padda: severe impurity [persists through decay] until [it is unfit for] a ger
